AP/PTI(AP10_30_2026_000236B) AUCKLAND: India middle-order batter Tilak Varma is likely to be added to the India A squad for the third unofficial Test against New Zealand A. TimesofIndia.com has learnt that the selectors want to give him some red-ball exposure, and the schedule allows him to feature in one four-day fixture before joining the ODI squad for the final two matches in Tauranga. Watch Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma and a lot of fun in Auckland Tilak, who is not part of the squad for the first three ODIs, will have no competitive cricket between November 2 and the fourth ODI on November 13. The southpaw could soon be asked to join the India A squad in Christchurch. The third unofficial Test begins on November 7 at Bert Sutcliffe Oval in Lincoln. Join conversation

 Bumrah leaves for New Zealand; doubts over Pant 
 Meanwhile, India's ace fast bowler Jasprit Bumrah will board a flight to New Zealand from Bengaluru on November 1. He checked into the BCCI Centre of Excellence (CoE) on October 25 for a routine assessment ahead of the third unofficial Test and the two-match Test series. "Bumrah didn't go to the CoE to increase his workload. It was just a routine assessment, and he has ticked all the necessary boxes before boarding the flight," a source tracking developments told TimesofIndia.com. It is further understood that, as per the original plans, Bumrah was supposed to travel with Rishabh Pant , who is undergoing rehabilitation at the CoE. However, Pant's Return to Play (RTP) has been delayed. The wicketkeeper-batter remains touch-and-go for the third unofficial Test and will continue his recovery under the watchful eyes of the BCCI medical team at the CoE. Poll Vote & Share your view
